# Almenara

> Almenara (Almenara LED) is a Madrid-based LED technology company. It brings to Europe LED modules with patented Dicrotec technology: the module is the board that produces the light inside a luminaire. Almenara does not make luminaires and does not compete with its partners.

It works in three ways: module supply to integrators, installers and maintainers; alliances with manufacturers and distributors who integrate or resell the modules under the seal "With Dicrotec technology · Almenara LED"; and light as a service (installation, maintenance and operation paid for by a monthly fee from the saving, with no upfront investment).

Key facts (each figure with its condition):
- Luminous efficacy: 300 lm/W in Dicrotec indoor modules (LED 3030), LM-79 test at an accredited laboratory (NVLAP); 230–235 lm/W in outdoor and street-lighting modules (LED 5050)
- Energy: −58% indoors at 2,000 lm and −46% outdoors at 8,400 lm, against a standard LED module at equal flux (6.7 W against 16 W at 2,000 lm)
- Nominal life: over 100,000 hours (standard LED: under 50,000 hours)
- Patent: MX 383389, filed in 33 further countries and granted in the United States and China, among others
- Warranty: 10 years at maximum rated current and temperature
- Vision 2030: 10% of the European LED lighting market. A declared objective, not a share already won
- Partners sought: manufacturers who license the technology, industrial groups who manufacture it under licence in their region, distributors, and engineering firms and installers who carry out retrofit projects. Territory, exclusivity and economic terms are negotiated with each partner and are not published
- Headquarters: Madrid, Spain. Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian
- Contact: info@almenaraled.com
